story.title: Rescue Efforts Underway After Nairobi Building Collapse Leaves Five Missing
story.summary: A multi-storey building in Nairobi collapsed while still under construction, resulting in two people being rescued and five others reported missing. Police have initiated a manhunt for the building's owner and contractor. Additionally, police used tear gas to disperse crowds and looters at the scene.

related_stories.title: Israel Implements Restrictions in West Bank Ahead of Elections Following Soldier Deaths
related_stories.summary: In the lead-up to elections, Israel has announced the closure of all land crossings between Israel and the West Bank on election day. This decision follows a deadly attack in Hebron that resulted in the deaths of two Israeli soldiers. Concurrently, Israeli military operations have led to the displacement of approximately 1,200 Palestinians from their homes in Hebron, as part of a broader crackdown in response to the attack.
